metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for Fugaro, the fleeting cloud workers that run coding-agent tasks and always end with a pull request.

plugins.name: fugaro
plugins.description: Nine skills for Fugaro: set a repository up, work with runs, route work between cloud and local, plan parallel work, upgrade a checkout to the installed fugaro, read and record a project's orchestrator state, set up a project's images, turn a spec into one reviewed documents pull request with a parallel plan, and land a pull request that is ready or stalled. Fugaro runs coding-agent tasks in fleeting cloud containers and always ends with a pull request.
